Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
> [abo] [reflex] Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is played.
>
> Not sure whether you could play another frenzy on top of it, in the cases of
> Rötschrek (o-o-t Master) or say Terror Frenzy / Drawing out the Beast.

Sure, although you cannot play the same frenzy card if that frenzy card
explicitly restricts itself from being played twice (e.g., superior
Terror Frenzy, Drawing Out the Beast, &c.)
